'''Kraken''' was a [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] that served under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]], and [[Gender/Legends|he]] was later tasked with delivering [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].

==Biography==
In an effort to retrieve Tup, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] along with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] boarded the Separatist shuttle and took down the droids guarding Tup. Kraken fought Skywalker in hand-to-hand combat before Skywalker cut off the droid's hands with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Kraken was questioned about his knowledge of why the Separatists wanted Tup, but the droid would not say, resulting in Skywalker decapitating Kraken.<ref name="The Unknown" />

[[File:DookuKrakenBridge-CrisisattheHeart.png|thumb|left|300px|Kraken served under the command of Count Dooku himself during the Battle of Scipio.]]
Later, Kraken was rebuilt and partook in the [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|Battle of Scipio]]. By order of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Kraken dispatched mutiple hyena bombers to destroy the Republic forces on the planet. Soon after, Kraken's fleet was attacked by republic ships led by Anakin Skywalker. Dooku, who had returned from his mission on Scipio, ordered Kraken to withdraw their forces. Kraken protested, saying that hundreds of droid forces had been left on the planet. Dooku dismissed Kraken's concerns and ordered the droid to withdraw. Kraken obeyed and retreated along with the rest of the Confederate forces, abandoning the droid forces on the planet.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />
